subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: What provider-reported cost metadata contract should OpenClaw expose for OpenRouter responses, and which runtime/session surfaces should consume it?
rationale: This affects stable runtime/session semantics, provider-cost precedence, and plugin/channel consumption, so a maintainer should choose the public API shape before implementation.

options.title: Add exact-cost metadata contract
options.body: Expose provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source/units/raw details and keep local estimates as a fallback path.

options.title: Keep exact cost outside core
options.body: Leave core on estimated cost fields and route exact OpenRouter accounting to a plugin or external ledger surface.

options.title: Fold into broader usage ledger
options.body: Defer this issue until the native per-call usage ledger and agent-facing usage API define the shared contract.

recommendation.title: Add exact-cost metadata contract
recommendation.body: Expose provider-reported cost as additive structured metadata with source/units/raw details and keep local estimates as a fallback path.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-history owner for OpenRouter cost reconciliation and related usage/session surfaces.
